summary: Since ansible-core 2.11, callback plugins get meta tasks through v2_playbook_on_task_start; only explicit meta tasks are sent by default, and setting self.wants_implicit_tasks = True also delivers internally generated tasks, which carry Task.implicit to tell them apart.
questions: Do callback plugins receive meta tasks?
How do I get implicit tasks in a callback plugin?
How can a callback tell if a task was generated by Ansible?

answer_card.title: Receive implicit tasks in a callback
answer_card.answer_md:
Since ansible-core 2.11, `v2_playbook_on_task_start` is called for meta tasks. By default only explicit `meta` tasks from the play are sent.

To also receive tasks Ansible generates internally, set this in your callback:

```python
self.wants_implicit_tasks = True
```

Each `Task` object then has an `.implicit` attribute that tells you whether Ansible or the user created it.
